scope: Ford Torino / Gran Torino / Gran Torino Brougham / Gran Torino Sport, 1972-1976 (Squire wagons included). Ranchero and (Gran Torino) Elite are separate models and excluded; their NHRA rows were used only for context. All hp are SAE net. Ford's 1972-76 Torino sales literature lists engines by CID and carburetor but prints no hp, so ratings rest on NHRA plus publications.
